verdict.rationale: Sift is an ML fraud-detection SaaS that ingests customer event data, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence documents no such control. The docs instead say Sift "gets smarter the more data it has," and the sandbox only keeps test events from affecting production scores. That is an adjacent testing feature, not a way to stop data being used for model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
